from solution import order_changes as f
v=[(9,1,10,0,1),(4,1,2,0,5),(3,1,2,0,1),(2,1,2,0,1)];copy=v.copy()
assert f(v)==[2,3,4,9] and v==copy
assert f([(1,1,0,0,0),(1,2,0,0,0)]) is None and f([(1,-1,0,0,0)]) is None
